verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party organizations, memberships, or org-invitation primitives in Supabase Auth. It shows only developer building blocks: linking auth data to your own tables via triggers and foreign keys, RLS-scoped tokens, and a custom access token hook. The only invite mention is a user-level signup invite when signup is disabled, not a tenant or org invitation flow. These are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward an out-of-the-box multi-tenant model.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations, memberships, and invitation flows out of the box
